join nextstrain report with ha coverage

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

ha_nextclade = read_tsv("source/20250429_IV25Run15_nextstrain_snapshot/nextstrain/results/vic/ha/nextclade.tsv")
nextstrain_report = read_tsv("source/20250429_IV25Run15_nextstrain_snapshot/nextstrain/reports/report.tsv")

df = left_join(nextstrain_report, ha_nextclade, by = c("sequence_ID" = "seqName")) |> 
    filter(type == "InfluenzaB")

```
